mask_rules.note: a mask at/above the coverage ratio or hole ratio NEVER grants an edit permission

provenance_rules.ci_fixture: never counts as production; require_production refuses it

purpose: Seed and track every real role/prop of a source span into the sealed frame->mask->track artifact mf.source_role_tracks.v1. Masks come from a REAL segmenter; a CI fixture source may never be recorded as production.

steps.detail: real availability probe of the segmenter: checkpoint stat + torch zip magic + sam2 package import + torch backend; record concrete path/bytes/device, never a bare name
declared real seeds (role_id, kind, box, declare_frames)
per-frame mask on the REAL decoded frame; digest + measured stats
single instance id per seed, occlusion runs, no re-identification
check_artifact invariants + require_production at publication time

track_rules.instance_id_policy: one id per seed for the whole declared span; occlusion keeps the id
track_rules.partial_character_policy: partial-required roles are mandatory: any gap refuses ROLE_TRACKS_PARTIAL_DROPPED
